display.entryTitle: First Turn Paint Cans Inverted Mickey

description: After the first left turn, while the train is still in one piece, a stack of paint cans holds an upside-down Hidden Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: Right after the first left turn, before the train breaks apart
whereToLook.exactSpot: The paint cans. Three cans grouped as an inverted head and ears.

bestTip: Upside down is the clue. Tilt your head.
